'''Crandor''' is a small volcanic island north of [[Karamja]]. Players are unable to [[Sailing|sail]] to Crandor themselves, but can buy the [[Lady Lumbridge|last remaining ship that can handle Crandor's reefs]] from [[Klarense]]. Players seek out this boat during [[Dragon Slayer I]], when the [[Guildmaster]] tasks them with defeating the mighty [[dragon]] [[Elvarg]].

==History==
Crandor was once an important city-state with a thriving community. It was considered to be as politically important as [[Falador]] or [[Varrock]], and traded with all{{CiteNPC|npc=Duke Horacio|quote=Back in my father's day, Crandor was an important city-state. Politically, it was as important as Falador or Varrock and its ships traded with every port.|loc=Dragon Slayer I|notes=|name=}} Its inhabitants had a great tradition of being mages and adventurers, with many of them even earning their place in the [[Champions' Guild]].{{CiteNPC|npc=Guildmaster|quote=Thirty years ago, Crandor was a thriving community with a great tradition of mages and adventurers. Many Crandorians even earned the right to be part of the Champions' Guild!|loc=Dragon Slayer I|notes=|name=}} However, one of these adventurers went too far, descending into the volcano in the centre of the island and waking the dragon [[Elvarg]].{{CiteNPC|npc=Guildmaster|quote=One of their adventurers went too far, however. He descended into the volcano in the centre of Crandor and woke the dragon Elvarg.|loc=Dragon Slayer I|notes=|name=}} The dragon, engineered to be extremely aggressive by the [[dragonkin]] [[Zorgoth]],{{CiteText|text=Old notes (Dragon Slayer II)|quote=This trial was different though, the subject did not reject the spores as previous ones did. Alas, the results were unsatisfactory. The subject displayed heightened aggression, as desired. However, its strength is unchanged and its mental capacity is limited.}} proceeded to kill the adventurer, and left the volcano to lay waste to Crandor.{{CiteNPC|npc=Guildmaster|quote=He must have fought valiantly against the dragon because they say that, to this day, she has a scar down her side, but the dragon still won the fight. She emerged and laid waste to the whole of Crandor with her fire breath!|loc=Dragon Slayer I|notes=|name=}}

Some refugees managed to escape and set up camp north of [[Rimmington]], but Elvarg followed them there and wiped them out as well.{{CiteNPC|npc=Guildmaster|quote=Some refugees managed to escape in fishing boats. They landed on the coast, north of Rimmington, and set up camp but the dragon followed them and burned the camp to the ground.|loc=Dragon Slayer I|notes=|name=}} Only three Crandorians survived: a trio of wizards named [[Thalzar]], [[Lozar]] and [[Melzar the Mad|Melzar]], who escaped via magic and split up the only surviving [[Crandor map|map]] through the reefs to Crandor as they couldn't bring themselves to destroy it, and went their separate ways.{{CiteNPC|npc=Guildmaster|quote=After what happened, people were afraid of enraging the dragon. Most maps to the island were destroyed, but I have heard that one survived. It was held by Melzar, Thalzar and Lozar.|loc=Dragon Slayer I|notes=|name=}} Lozar built a [[Lozar's house|home in Lumbridge]], and Thalzar built a vault in the [[Dwarven Mine]]. Melzar settled north of Rimmington, building a [[Melzar's Maze|castle]] at the site of the refugee camp. He sought to use necromancy to revive the survivors but was slowly driven to madness in the process; he failed to successfully resurrect the survivors, only getting as far as conjuring their [[Ghost (Melzar's Maze)|spirits]] and reanimating their remains as [[skeleton (Melzar's Maze)|skeletons]] and [[zombie (Melzar's Maze)|zombies]] separately.{{CiteText|text=Melzar's notes}}

The mainland was terrified that Elvarg would follow the wizards there and lay waste to all of Asgarnia and Misthalin,{{CiteNPC|npc=Duke Horacio|quote=I remember my father being very scared. He posted lookouts on the roof to warn if the dragon was approaching. All the city rulers were worried that Elvarg would devastate the whole continent.|loc=Dragon Slayer I|notes=|name=}} but thankfully, Elvarg returned to her cave under the volcano. Some time later, a brave adventurer found the pieces of the map, learned the path to Crandor, and ventured down into the volcano to vanquish the fearsome dragon. However, Elvarg did manage to score one final casualty, slaying [[Cabin Boy Jenkins|the cabin boy on the adventurer's ship]]. The cabin boy, Jenkins, later appeared in the wreck of the ship as a ghost, and began [[Crew Management|offering his services]] to players looking for help while [[Sailing]].

==Transportation==
[[File:Crandor and Karamja Dungeon wall.png|left|thumb|200x200px|Location of the false wall.]]
Crandor is first accessed by boat during the [[Dragon Slayer I]] [[quest]]. Players must obtain all three map pieces and repair the boat; after this, Ned will bring them to the island. After the quest, Crandor can only be accessed via a secret door in the [[Crandor and Karamja Dungeon]].

To reach the Crandor surface, players must first enter the Karamja Volcano, either by exiting the TzHaar City, or by climbing down from Karamja. The wall can be found in the north-west corner of the area. After passing the wall, players can run north, to the rope they placed during Dragon Slayer I, and climb up the rope to reach the surface.
{{Clear|left}}
[[File:Elvarg.png|thumb|The fearsome dragon Elvarg.]]

==Locations==
Crandor has multiple ores which players can mine through the [[Mining]] skill, labelled on the map with a small pickaxe. There are four [[List of mines|mining areas]] on the island, each guarded by their own monster. Due to the level of the monsters and their drops, it's a common island for mid-to-high level [[free-to-play]] players to train on, especially when [[Ranged|ranging]] from the many [[safespots]]. All of the monsters attack with [[melee]]. Players can encounter these monsters again in the dungeon below, as well as [[Deadly red spider|deadly red spiders]] and [[Elvarg]].

=== Dungeon ===
Underneath the island is a dungeon which connects to [[Karamja]], labelled on the map with a red exclamation mark. Players can climb down the hole at the top of the island to enter. In it are more skeletons, [[lesser demon]]s, and Elvarg, as well as some [[giant bats]] and [[deadly red spiders]] on the Karamjan side.

Elvarg resides in her own section of the dungeon. To the north of her cave is a laboratory, accessed during [[Dragon Slayer II]].

== Inhabitants ==
The inhabitant is [[Cabin Boy Jenkins]], who returns to the island [[Cabin Boy Jenkins (ghost)|as a ghost]] after [[Dragon Slayer I]] is complete. Beyond him, the island has many monsters:

==Trivia==
*After completing [[Dragon Slayer I]] quest, [[Ned]] can be found on the broken ship on Crandor, but will not talk about the task for the [[Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]].
*Crandor is the only island to be fully accessed on [[free-to-play]].
**A few tiles on the western side of the island are not accessible on free-to-play worlds, as they formerly played the members' only track [[Fruits de Mer]]. Although Fruits de Mer was removed from Crandor in April 2021, the tiles still remain members-only.
*Prior to an update on [[18 June]] [[2007]], Crandor was covered in lush foliage.
*On the south-western part of the island, next to the [[mithril rocks]], there are three so-called [[Game_square#Types_of_tiles|'force-walk'-tiles]] that will force the player to another tile when stepped on.
